scopes.description: Allows creating new agents in a project.
Allows deleting agents.
Allows running agents in chat.

Allows publishing agents.
Allows reading agent configuration and history.
Allows unpublishing agents.
Allows updating, building, publishing, and managing integrations of agents.

Allows reading the AI preferences saved for the instance, the user, and their projects.
Allows creating new annotation tags.
Allows connecting an own account to an end-user credential.
Allows creating, deleting, and changing the type of end-user credentials, which resolve to each user's own connection.
Allows creating, updating, and deleting provider connections used by instance-level features. These connections are not available in workflows.
Allows removing credential shares.
Allows using any credential on the instance in a workflow, without being a member of its project. Without it, a role that can read credentials sees them but cannot select, test, or run them.

Allows listing and rotating instance encryption keys.
Allows deleting executions of workflows in the project.
Allows listing executions of workflows the role can view.
Allows viewing executions of workflows the role can view.

Allows creating Git connections and their authentication material.
Allows deleting Git connections and their local files.
Allows listing Git connections.
Allows adding projects to and removing projects from a Git connection.
Allows importing all projects from a Git connection working copy into the instance.
Allows pushing all projects linked to a Git connection to its remote repository.
Allows reading Git connection configuration. Secrets are never returned.
Allows updating Git connections, including their authentication material.
Allows reading insights data.
Allows managing which node types are available, on the instance or in a project.
Allows including projects in a portable package export.
Allows adding members to a project, changing a member's project role, and removing members.
Allows creating, editing, and deleting project role definitions.
Allows listing evaluation test runs for a workflow.
Allows reading evaluation test runs and their per-case results.
Allows executing workflows in chat.
Allows including workflows in a portable package export.
Allows importing workflows from a portable package into the project.
Allows publishing workflows.
Allows unpublishing workflows.
Allows removing workflow shares.

global:admin.description: Full control of the instance, including all workflows and credentials

global:chatUser.description: Can only use workflows through the chat interface, not build them

global:member.description: Can create and use their own workflows and credentials

project:admin.description: Full control of settings, members, workflows, credentials and executions

project:chatUser.description: Chat-only access to chatting with workflows that have n8n Chat enabled

project:editor.description: Create, edit, and delete workflows, credentials, and executions

project:viewer.description: Read-only access to workflows, credentials, and executions

secretsProviderConnection:owner.description: Full control of secrets provider connection settings and secrets

secretsProviderConnection:user.description: Read-only access to use secrets from the connection
